intro.question:
How to train for a
one-arm pull-up
on a pincher

steps.title:
Swap one handle
for a pincher.
steps.body:
Now your thumb has to
hold every rep.

steps.title: Find your start.
steps.body:
The hardest hole where you
still get 5 clean pull-ups.

steps.title:
Try to keep
the bar level.
steps.body:
Tilts a lot? Your assist
arm is doing too much.

steps.title:
Combine it with
weighted pull-ups.
steps.body:
One builds the strength.
The other makes it one-arm.

cards.s:
shift load to
your pinch hand
in 5% steps

outro.title:
Save this for your
next pull session.
